date_note: Date is WORLD's first notice of 17 November; the page was updated on 20 November with the counts. Cybersecurity.com reports Plaid detected the unauthorized access to KARTE on 13 November.
title: Tinpan Alley (RAGTAG) says member data of 最大37万人 may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: WORLD says PLAID told it that unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE service leaked part of the group's data stored there. In its 20 November update, the notice gives the count for its subsidiary Tinpan Alley as 最大37万人 and for WORLD Online Store as 最大3,700件. Cybersecurity.com reports Plaid detected the unauthorized access on 13 November.
plain: WORLD says a breach at its vendor PLAID's KARTE service leaked some member data, 最大37万人 at its subsidiary Tinpan Alley.
exec: A vendor's marketing platform leak may have exposed data of 最大37万人 at one retail group subsidiary, according to WORLD's notice.
action: WORLD says it is still verifying the scope and will promptly announce any additional required actions, and refers readers to PLAID's notice for the incident overview.

validation.note: WORLD's own notice read (via a page-reader tool that returned quoted Japanese fragments, not the full text). Cybersecurity.com (Japan) read for the 13 November date. Tinpan Alley's own notice (ragtag.jp) failed to load.

review.note: stronger than the source: 13 Nov is Plaid's detection date per Cybersecurity.com, not the access date; summary and date_note reworded
